prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1047; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now seeking appropriate compensation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with the declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you identify the claim representative assigned to this file.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to the collision is preserved. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, witness contact details, repair estimates, appraisal reports, and any internal notes or claim file materials. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such records while this matter is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
